thread:
Maia: Quick question — can we move next week's cross‑func sync from Wed 09:00 PST to Thu 11:00 PST? Need to carve out a full 45m for RFC reviews + give APAC folks a slightly better window.
Jasper: Thu 11 works for me. will need to skip the first 10m for a calendar conflict though.
Ravi: Prefer Thu too, Wednesday's sprint demo collides. Thu 11 would let me present the triage backlog.
Lena: I have a 1:1 at 11:30 but can shuffle. Is the plan to make this the RFC deep‑dive slot?
Maia: Yes — propose agenda: 1) quick roadmap alignment (5m) 2) two RFC reviews (25m) 3) triage highlights + decisions (10m) 4) action items + rollouts (5m). Can someone own the RFC queue?
Jasper: I can own RFC #1 (serving runtime kernel selector). @Ravi can you take RFC #2 (smart routing fallback)?
Ravi: Yup I'll take RFC #2. Can someone add the RFC PR links in the calendar invite?
Maia: I'll update the invite. engbot: added calendar link -> https://calendar.company.com/event/4b2f9 (edited)
Lena: Who's taking notes / decision log? We should append to the product decision log after the call.
Jasper: I can capture notes and post to the decision log. Will ping after meeting with the summary + action items.
Maia: Awesome. Also: can we run a short pre‑read thread so reviewers aren't surprised? Drop PR links + 1‑para summary in this thread by EOD Tue.
Ravi: I'll paste my RFC summary here tomorrow.
Lena: I'll do pre‑read comments by Tue evening.
Jasper: Small ask — can we put a hard stop at 11:45? I've got a followup call I can't move.
Maia: Noted. We'll target 45m hard stop. If we need extra time, plan a followup async decision or separate deep‑dive.
engbot: poll created -> What time for next cross‑func sync? Options: Wed 09:00 PST, Thu 11:00 PST (current), Fri 08:00 PST. Vote here: /poll 1719501234
Maia: Thanks all — summary: Thu 11:00 PST, 45m hard stop, Jasper owns notes, Jasper/Ravi own RFCs, pre‑reads by EOD Tue. I'll update invite and add decision log link. :thumbsup:
Jasper: noted, will prep slides for RFC #1.
Ravi: prepping perf numbers for RFC #2.
Lena: will move my 1:1 and add a short design snippet to the pre‑read.
Maia: closing thread — calendar updated and decision log link added: https://docs.company.com/decision-log/crossfunc-sync
